overview.title: Providers
overview.description: Choose a default provider and set a default model for each connection.

empty.noMatchesDescription: Try a connection or provider name.
empty.firstDescription: Add an account, API key, cloud service or local connection.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnect.description: Credentials will be removed. Saved model references remain available for repair.
disconnect.defaultNote: New tasks using the app default will require reconnection or another default provider.
disconnect.missingProvider: This provider is no longer registered.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Default approval tier for new tasks. Each task can change its own tier from the composer.

manual.label: Manual approval
manual.description: Ask before every file or terminal action.

auto.label: Auto approval
auto.description: A model checks each action against your request. Safe actions run; risky ones still ask.

always.label: Always allow
always.description: Never ask. Terminal commands and files outside the task folder run unattended.

errors.save: The permission setting could not be saved.

shellAllowlist.title: Shell allowlist
shellAllowlist.description: Commands that start with an entry run right away: without asking under Manual approval, and without a review under Auto approval. Commands that chain, redirect or substitute always ask.
shellAllowlist.empty: No commands yet. Add a prefix above, or choose “Always allow” when you approve a command.

errors.tooLong: Keep entries to 200 characters or fewer.
errors.invalid: Use a program name and plain arguments, without quotes or shell symbols.
errors.duplicate: This entry is already on the list.
errors.limit: The allowlist holds at most 100 entries.
errors.save: The allowlist could not be saved.

shellAllowlist.detailDescription: Commands that start with this prefix run right away.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Make the app work at your pace. Click a shortcut to edit it.
shortcuts.registeredByDesktop: The desktop app registers this shortcut while it is running.

status.recordingHint: Press a shortcut. Escape cancels; Tab moves to the next control.
status.openAtLoginApproval: Approve AI in System Settings › Login Items to finish.

errors.register: This shortcut could not be registered. Choose another combination.
errors.unsupportedCombination: This key combination is not supported. Try another shortcut.
errors.modifierRequired: Include a modifier such as Command, Control, or Alt.
errors.shortcutSave: The shortcut could not be saved.
errors.defaultsRestore: Default shortcuts could not be restored.
errors.windowPreferenceSave: The window preference could not be saved.

extensions.filesTruncated: This folder is too large to list in full.
extensions.fileBinary: This file is not text, so it is not shown.
extensions.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to show.

agentPermissions.title: Permissions for {{name}}
agentPermissions.description: Applies from the next run and never exceeds the task's own permissions.
agentPermissions.limitToolsDescription: Off: every tool the task allows, including MCP and memory.
agentPermissions.noTools: Choose at least one tool, or turn off Limit tools.

grep.label: Search contents

fetch_content.label: Read web pages

extensions.mcpDetailDescription: How this server connects and what it offers.
extensions.removeDescription: The server leaves the catalog, so later runs can't use it. Its sign-in is not revoked.
extensions.restoreDescription: The version that ships with the app replaces your edited copy. Your current copy is backed up first.
extensions.restoreDone: Restored the built-in {{name}} and backed up your copy.
extensions.restoreBackupPath: Your previous copy of {{name}} was backed up to {{path}}
extensions.sessionOpened: Opened a new AI session in the task panel.
extensions.enableCreateSkill: Enable {{name}} in Skills before creating with AI.
extensions.allowedSkillsHint: One skill name per line, up to 128.
extensions.roleSkillsLimit: A role can allow at most 128 skills.

skillPage.addDescription: Install an existing skill from a folder or package. To write a new skill, use Create with AI.

sourceHint.local: The absolute path of a folder that contains SKILL.md. The folder is copied, so use Update after you change it.
sourceHint.npm: The name of an npm package already installed among the service's managed packages. Nothing is downloaded.
sourceHint.git: The repository URL. Its package must already be installed among the service's managed packages; enter that package's name as the skill name. Nothing is downloaded.

skillPage.nameHint: Leave empty to use the folder or package name.
skillPage.sourceRequired: Enter a source to install from.
skillPage.builtinCurrent: Same as the version that ships with the app

agentPage.addDescription: Define a specialist the task can hand work to. It is saved to ~/.atd/agents.
agentPage.nameHint: Letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores, starting with a letter or number. It also names the file.
agentPage.descriptionPlaceholder: When the task should hand work to this subagent
agentPage.toolsHint: With none selected, the subagent can use every tool the task allows.
agentPage.toolsOverridden: Custom permissions replace these tools in later runs. Change them under Permissions.
agentPage.modelHint: Saved in the agent file for other tools. Runs in this app always use the task's model.
agentPage.systemPromptPlaceholder: Describe the subagent's role, how it works, and what it reports back.

errors.namePattern: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores, starting with a letter or number.
errors.nameTaken: A subagent with this name already exists.

mcpPage.label: MCP server
mcpPage.addDescription: Connect a local command or a remote server so runs can use its tools, resources, and prompts.
mcpPage.authCodeNote: Finish signing in with your browser. If it shows an authorization code, paste it in this server's row in the list.
mcpPage.serverIdHint: Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. The ID can't be changed after the server is added.
mcpPage.transportStdioHint: Starts the command on this computer and talks to it over standard input and output.
mcpPage.transportHttpHint: Connects to a remote server at the URL over Streamable HTTP.
mcpPage.transportSseHint: Connects to an older remote server that streams over Server-Sent Events.
mcpPage.argumentsHint: One argument per line. Spaces stay part of the argument, so no quoting is needed.
mcpPage.tokenEnvHint: The service reads the token from this environment variable when it connects. If the variable is unset, it uses the token saved in the system credential store.
mcpPage.oauthHint: After saving, choose Authenticate to sign in with your browser.
mcpPage.unkeptNote: This page can't edit these settings. Saving keeps them, except when you switch between a command and a URL transport, which drops the ones that no longer apply.

errors.serverIdInvalid: Use up to 128 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.
errors.serverIdTaken: A server with this ID already exists.
errors.commandRequired: Enter the command that starts the server.
errors.argumentsInvalid: Use at most 100 arguments of up to 4,096 characters each.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.tokenEnvRequired: Enter the environment variable that holds the token.
errors.tokenEnvInvalid: Use letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit.

service.rolesNote: Subagent roles bounding what a run may use. Edits apply to the next run.
